scope: Local release verification; no remote CI or registry publication is implied.
privacy: Thread, job, compaction and turn identifiers, paths, fingerprints and handoff contents are intentionally omitted. The original local journal was inspected by the resumed agent; this record is a summary, not independently verifiable raw evidence.
limits: This release has one observed live compaction/resume sample; it does not establish a latency distribution or a worst-case duration.
The 15-minute worker deadline includes idle waiting and has not been validated across representative large threads.
The current revision was not tested locally on Linux because WSL could not start; Windows/Linux Node 20/22 CI is configured but has not yet run.
